tei:div.tei:p: "$ (325)༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/// /

(326)༄༅// rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la// rnam dkar dbang bzhi'i char rgyun legs phab nas// rnam grol sku bzhi'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen nag po pa// ḍa ma ru pa a wa dhū ti pa// ga ya dha ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/ kha skong tshogs bshad dpal e waṃ pa'i rgyal tshab kho na las brgyud pa ltar na/ bu dha shrī ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal tshab kun dbang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang po// bsod nams lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// bsod nams dpal ldan dpal ldan chos skyong (327)zhabs// chos skyong bzang po nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shes so// yang dpal sa skya nas brgyud pa ltar na// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// zhes pa yon gang ltar mtshams su// sngags 'chang chos rje kun dga' rin chen dang*// bsod nams dbang po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' bsod nams kun dga' bkra shis dang*// bsod nams rin chen kun dga' blo gros zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med skyabs kun 'dus pa'i dngos// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes sbyar te/ des mtshon nas rang rang gis thob yul dang sprel shes par bya'o// slob bshad kyi brgyud pa ltar na/

sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i mtshams/ brgyud srol kun 'dus bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spangs chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*// dbang phyug rab brtan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar rje// kun dga' blos gros nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes so// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs (328)kyis// nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis snying la shar// 'bras bu'i yon tan thos pas yid spro ste// gsang chen lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du// bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim lam bsgom pas// rtsa yi 'gros kyis lus kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// sprul sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// bha ga byang sems nang gi dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba'i dbang bskur gtum mo'i lam bsgoms pas// yi ge'i 'gros kyis ngag gi sgrib sbyangs nas// longs sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob byang sems gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// gsum pa'i dbang bskur pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas// bdud rtsi'i 'gros kyis yid kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// chos sku'i go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// don dam byang sems mthar thug dkyil 'khor du// bzhi pa'i dbang bskur rba rlabs lam bsgoms pas// rlung gi 'gros kyis sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// ngo bo nyid sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// de ma thob pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du// mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas// bsam don chos dang mthun par legs grub ste// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i zhal skong 'di'ang bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig// /sarba mang ga laṃ//
